name: Peony Post
tagline: The command center every wedding vendor was promised but never got.
positioning: Peony Post is the per-seat CRM built for florists, photographers, and planners who run the whole show themselves.

hero.h1: Run every wedding like you have a full staff.
hero.sub: Peony Post turns the chaos of inquiries, contracts, and day-of timelines into one calm workspace — so solo florists, photographers, and planners can book more couples without hiring more people.

features.title: Inquiries that answer themselves
features.description: Auto-reply to every 'are you free on our date?' with availability, packages, and a booking link before your competitor even opens the email.

features.title: Contracts and deposits, one click
features.description: Send a branded proposal, collect the signature, and take the retainer in a single flow. No more chasing PDFs across three inboxes.

features.title: Day-of timelines that hold
features.description: Build the ceremony-to-last-dance schedule once, then share live views with the couple, the venue, and your second shooter.

features.title: Payment reminders on autopilot
features.description: Milestone invoices nudge couples before final payment is due, so the awkward money text is one you never have to send again.

features.title: Every couple in one place
features.description: Notes, mood boards, guest counts, and dietary quirks live on one client card your whole team can actually find.

features.title: Reports that read like advice
features.description: See which packages, seasons, and referral sources actually pay — then price your next wedding with confidence.

testimonials.quote: I booked eleven weddings the month I switched. Peony Post replies to inquiries at 2am so I don't have to, and the deposit hits before I've even met the couple.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The day-of timeline alone saved my sanity. My second shooter, the DJ, and the venue coordinator all see the same schedule now. No more walkie-talkie panic.
testimonials.name: Devin Ashcroft

testimonials.quote: I run my planning business solo and it finally feels like I have an office manager. Contracts, invoices, reminders — all handled while I'm on site.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For the one-person studio doing it all beautifully.
For growing teams booking back-to-back weekends.
For multi-location vendors and busy referral networks.

homepage.footerBlurb: Peony Post is the per-seat CRM for wedding vendors who refuse to let a spreadsheet run the biggest day of someone's life.
